Who we are

We are a quantitative investment firm, specializied in digital assets.
Our approaches are deeply linked with our core philosophy about the nature of financial markets: Everything is constantly evolving.

Our strengths lie in algorithmic execution, quantitative strategies, systematic trading and advanced systems architecture.

What we do

We operate in a dynamic market environment where we continuously update our understanding of market behavior through data. By identifying patterns and trends, we aim to build a more informed view of potential market inefficiencies.
